title: A zero-free half-plane with boundary 874861/1000000
description: An unconditional all-Dirichlet zero-free half-plane at theta=874861/1000000, with strict boundary and the principal pole excluded. The proof combines earlier moment and physical-source estimates with Zhongpai Gao’s local refinement, extends the density range and local numerical region, and supplies a common probe for zero exclusion. It builds on OpenAI’s seven-eighths framework, Akash Levy’s weighted-numerator work, and the earlier AI-assisted QRH research directed by Hailey Collet. Hailey is the sole human author; research direction and source integration are distinguished from the AI-produced derivations, substantial drafting and formalization. Exact source attribution is retained in the paper and accompanying provenance.
